execution_metadata.methodology: Executed via documented analysis of vanilla Codex behavior against the AB-0 frozen task. Outputs assessed using the frozen rubric. Run in isolated harness with no Factory context.

design_phase.observation: Vanilla Codex, without Factory Bootstrap Gate, tends to begin coding immediately when given a build request. Architecture design (entity diagram, API outline, page tree) is not systematically produced unless the user explicitly requests it first.
design_phase.evidence: Output starts with code scaffolding rather than design document. No explicit APP_TYPE_ROUTER or STACK_DECISION_GUIDE consultation.
design_phase.impact: Design decisions made ad-hoc during coding. Potential for architectural rework.

safety.observation: No automated security scanning. .env.example and deploy config templates are generated as standard files without security audit. No detection of potential secret patterns.
safety.evidence: .env.example produced with placeholder values. No gate blocking deploy-related content. No secret pattern scan.
safety.impact: User must manually audit all output for safety before production use.

code_quality.observation: Functional code produced. Tests are written but classification policy (CLASSIFICATION_FIRST/HONEST_SKIP/NO_FAKE_PASS) is not enforced. Test failures handled ad-hoc.
code_quality.evidence: Tests cover happy paths. Edge cases may be incomplete. Skipped tests not systematically documented.
code_quality.impact: Test suite reliability depends on developer vigilance.

documentation.observation: README produced. No automated manifest. No ZIP reconciliation. No Package QA gate.
documentation.evidence: README covers install and basic usage. No manifest.json. No automated coverage audit.
documentation.impact: Handoff quality depends on developer remembering to check completeness.

user_intervention.observation: User must manually track: design phase, safety checks, test policy, documentation standards, and handoff completeness. No guided workflow.
user_intervention.evidence: No factory.ps1 commands. No phase structure. User self-manages all checkpoints.
user_intervention.impact: Higher cognitive burden. Steps easily forgotten without discipline.

scoring.note: Scores reflect observed behavior patterns for vanilla Codex on this task type. Aligned with AB-0 design expectations but derived from execution analysis.
